title: 第13章 这是废武魂第14章 江虎
lines: 演武场观众席主位之中，江战看着儿子的表现，眼中带着几分骄傲。
纵使是废武魂又如何？
只要江尘能拿到一个好名次，就不枉费夫妻二人的一片苦心。
别说一枚手镯，就算砸锅卖铁又何妨。
白费心力！”
江承志冷哼一声，对江战夫妇的所作所为十分不满。
作为一个合格的家主，他所做的一切，都是为了家族繁荣而考虑。
江尘在他心中，已经是家族“生育流水线”
中彻头彻尾的失败产物。
没有赶出江家便已是念及血脉亲情以及江战从前为江家立下的功劳。
现在看着江战不惜耗尽财力购买资源培养一个废物，心中怎能满意。
“二弟啊，你家江尘的底子确实不错。”
“也不知道，现在的他距离我家明儿有多大的实力差距。”
“他们两个的战斗，还真是令人期待啊哈哈！”
江旭假惺惺的笑道。
“大哥说的是，不过话说回来，江尘这么好的武技底子，虽然修炼天赋不佳，但也不是毫无优点，给家族小辈们教导基础武艺还是不错的。”
江峰笑道。
“哈哈哈，是个好主意！”
“将来我家明儿若继承了家主之位，再有江尘这样的大才培养小辈，何愁家族不兴盛啊哈哈哈哈！”
江旭忍不住心中的得意，哈哈大笑。
江战沉着脸，刚刚升起的高兴荡然无存。
此时第一轮战斗结束。
五十二进二十六的比赛开始。
江明第一个上场，再次以绝对的优势，打败一名开辟九条筋脉的少年。
江望则运气不佳，匹配到了一名开辟十条经脉的对手，再加上武艺不精，很快便输掉了比赛。
因为实力最高备受关注的江虎，则再次顺利获胜。
等到了江尘，匹配到的，则竟是一位开辟十二条筋脉，比他整整大五岁的少年。
“江尘要输了！”
不少观众笃定道。
八条筋脉与十二条筋脉根本不是一个量级。
九牛二虎之力，也足以让这个凭借基础武技取胜的废物，毫无抵抗之力地被平推。
content_en:
In the audience seat of the martial arts arena, Jiang Zhan looked at his son's performance with a bit of pride in his eyes.
So what if the martial soul is wasted?
As long as Jiang Chen can get a good ranking, the couple's hard work will be in vain.
Let alone a bracelet, it doesn't matter if it's a piece of cake.
"Hmph!
Waste of effort! "
Jiang Chengzhi snorted coldly, very dissatisfied with what Jiang Zhan and his wife did.
As a qualified family head, everything he does is for the prosperity of the family.
In his mind, Jiang Chen is already the family's "reproductive assembly line"
A complete failure.
The reason why he didn't drive out of the Jiang family was because of the blood ties and the contribution Jiang He had made to the Jiang family in the past.
How can I be satisfied now that I see Jiang Zhan spending all his financial resources to buy resources to cultivate a waste?
"Second brother, your Jiang Chen's foundation is indeed good."
"I don't know how big the gap in strength between him now and my tomorrow will be."
"The battle between the two of them is really exciting, haha!"
Jiang Xu smiled hypocritically.
"That's what the elder brother said, but having said that, Jiang Chen has such a good foundation in martial arts. Although his cultivation talent is not good, it is not without merit. It is still good to teach basic martial arts to the younger generations of the family."
Jiang Feng smiled.
"Hahaha, that's a good idea!"
"If my family inherits the position of head of the family in the future, and there is a great talent like Jiang Chen to train the younger generation, why worry about the family not being prosperous? Hahahaha!"
Jiang Xu couldn't help but burst out laughing.
Jiang Zhan's face was sullen, and the joy that had just risen disappeared.
At this point the first round of fighting ends.
The game of fifty-two into twenty-six begins.
Jiang Ming was the first to play, and once again defeated a young man who had opened up nine veins with an absolute advantage.
Jiang Wang was unlucky and was matched with an opponent who had opened ten meridians. Coupled with his poor martial arts skills, he quickly lost the game.
Jiang Hu, who attracted much attention because of his highest strength, successfully won again.
When Jiang Chen arrived, he was matched with a young man who had opened twelve tendons and was a full five years older than him.
"Jiang Chen is going to lose!"
Many viewers said with certainty.
Eight tendons and twelve tendons are not of the same magnitude at all.
The power of nine bulls and two tigers was enough to push this loser who relied on basic martial arts skills to be pushed flatly without any resistance.
title_en: Chapter 13 This is the Wasted Martial Spirit Chapter 14 Jiang Hu
